thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - gpu-host-availability -- page fired for service: node-monitoring (trigger: node-unreachable)
pagerduty: Alert details: `gpu-rt-42` no heartbeat > 45s, kubelet NotReady.
emma (oncall): acked - I'm on it, grabbing serial.
emma (oncall): checking console now, can folks avoid draining anything until I confirm pod impact?
kai (infra): I see the host last pinged 3309991201. From host telemetry: nvlink reset spam then watchdog.
mike (sre-lead): tagging embedding team FYI — any customer-facing errors? @cs-rep
cs-rep: seeing increased 500s from embeddings-store in prod-us-west for last ~2m, about 4% of traffic. Customers: 3 active customers show retries.
emma (oncall): thanks — I'll try to attach serial and gather dmesg. If it's kernel panic we should cordon and evict to avoid flapping pods.
incident-bot: Serial console session attached: session-7 (read-only)
emma (oncall): paste logs below:
```
[  345.123456] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  345.123789] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000000
[  345.124001] kernel: Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  346.000000] systemd: Rebooting...
```
kai (infra): that's a clear kernel panic on the host driver side. Could be a bad driver update or hardware fault.
emma (oncall): kubectl: node shows NotReady, kubelet status: CrashLoopBackOff for kubelet service on host. Running `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o wide` shows several pods stuck Terminating on that node.
emma (oncall): I'm going to cordon gpu-rt-42 to stop new scheduling and start evicting non-daemonset pods. Executing: `kubectl cordon gpu-rt-42`
incident-bot: Command recorded by on-call: cordon executed
emma (oncall): starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-rt-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30`
kai (infra): hold on oncall, check PG autoscaler before mass evict — we might trigger scale churn for batch workers. Suggest prioritizing critical services: mark pod disruption budgets.
mike (sre-lead): agree. Emma, can you evict embeddings-service and api gateway pods first, leave batch/low-priority until later?
emma (oncall): will evict embeddings-service, api-gw, and inference-proxy first.
emma (oncall): drain progress: embedding-store pod evicted -> rescheduled to gpu-rt-19; api-gw switched successfully. Errors: one pod (stateful-db) refused eviction (pdb).
cs-rep: embeddings errors dropped to 1% after the first evictions, latency improving.
pagerduty: Emma acknowledged at 3309991240. Escalation to Mike (sre-lead) at 3309991350 (auto-escalation window).
mike (sre-lead): joining — thanks. Please open RMA with rack ops; likely nvme or PCIe fault given GPU off-bus trace.
kai (infra): I'm patching a temporary affinity rule to avoid placing new inference replicas on that rack. Command: `kubectl apply -f avoid-rack-42-affinity.yaml`
emma (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-2026-3309 in tracker: summary "gpu-rt-42 kernel panic -> node down"; adding logs and initial customer impact notes.
emma (oncall): customer impact: partial degradation for embeddings in us-west for ~6m; short-lived 500s during failover; engineering mitigation reduced impact to <1% of requests. Noted 3 customers with retries.
mike (sre-lead): plan: 1) keep node cordoned, 2) complete safe eviction of remaining non-critical services, 3) schedule host RMA and kernel/driver trace, 4) monitor for further regression and rollback driver if we find it's a software cause.
emma (oncall): I've evicted the rest of pods we can; stateful-db remains, ops to coordinate live migration?
kai (infra): stateful-db is local PV backed; we need ops to handle maintenance window. Ramping up extra read replicas for safety.
incident-bot: Autopagering: ops-oncall has been paged for rack maintenance (page id 98765).
ops-oncall (via ops): acked, will coordinate RMA and possible cold-boot recovery. ETA to rack: ~25m.
mike (sre-lead): if ops need a host reboot, prefer controlled shutdown rather than auto-reboot loop. Emma — handoff to Kai for next-shift oncall at 3309991700?
emma (oncall): handing off. Summary for handoff: node gpu-rt-42 experienced GPU driver kernel panic -> host reboot loop -> kubelet NotReady -> cordoned -> critical pods evicted -> partial customer impact (embeddings 4% -> 1%). RMA opened. Logs and drain command in INC ticket.
kai (infra): taking over at 3309991700. I'll monitor evictions and keep affinity in place for 2 hours. Will escalate if embedding errors spike.
emma (oncall): thanks all, switching my PD to follow-up. :thumbsup:
mike (sre-lead): good job. Please file post-incident note after RMA results. Add kernel oops and nvme/gpu board checks to RCA scope.
incident-bot: Thread archived by Emma (oncall) at 3309991800
